QuestInfo.name: [Snowflake Event] Flake Finder
QuestInfo.0: Go listen to Cassandra explain at length how to get snowflakes.\r\nTime well spent!
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra has asked you to collect snowflakes for this winter's celebration. \r\nYou can obtain them by hunting monsters within your level range.
QuestInfo.2: You collected the snowflakes and received an awesome chair!\r\nAnd you'll get something even better if you collect all 12 chairs.
